verdict.rationale: Kong is an API/AI gateway with a SaaS platform (Konnect), so a training opt-out or no-training data policy is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no such control or policy. The AI Gateway's DLP/PII-removal policies are an adjacent data-governance feature, not a mechanism that keeps customer data out of AI model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
